_doc: AI-23 opening-book constants until bot_profiles.json carries the `opening_book` block (needs content). 05 s7.3: book_end_s 300 (the book hands over to the reactive planner at 5:00), max_rejects 3 (three REJECTED_PLACEMENT skip a step), lock_s 60 (human_order_lock_s, s7.8); 05 s7.8 cmds_per_think 2/3/5/8 per tier (the CommandGovernor, AI-28, replaces the stand-in cap); site geometry is the planner's: structures are 6-74 m wide (9.2 m cells at 1024), the Core build radius is 600 m and the Pylon radius 250 m, so a Pylon chain starts at toward_first_m 450 (inside the Core's radius) and steps toward_step_m 220 (inside the previous Pylon's radius); outpost_cover 0.75: the home-trap Outpost site lies that share of the Outpost build radius short of the Cold Trap (and >= the 800 m spacing from the Core), so the Extractor is inside its radius; presence is 300 m (economy.json), so outpost_ring_m 40 x 4 rings plus move_agl_m 120 stays inside it.
